description: Local account screen can only use the four native authentication commands, the two fixed task reads, the live sync delta read, the four fixed task writes (create, complete, edit details, delete), the six fixed bulk and order writes (complete, delete, clear dates, set metadata or move a selection; reorder one task), the nine fixed label and saved-filter commands (list, open, create, edit, delete), the five fixed project commands (list, open, create, rename, delete), the twelve fixed goal commands (list, open, create, edit or archive, reorder, hide or show Goals, list links, link or unlink a project or task, read a task's goal suggestions, dismiss one, read a task's milestone, mark, edit or unmark it), the seven fixed season commands (read the current season, start one, add a goal to it, change a goal's tier or target, remove a goal from it, list past seasons, end it and start the next), the three fixed ritual commands (read the ritual settings and today's Check-in, save the settings, record a finished or skipped ritual with its ratings), the four fixed organization commands (move destinations, create and delete a section, move or nest one task), the three attachment commands (list a task's attachments, upload files to a project, save an attachment), the nine connected-calendar commands (events, accounts, show an account's events, show or hide a calendar, resync, disconnect, open and stop the live change stream, open an event in Google Calendar), the three Google sign-in commands (start, await, cancel), Ramble socket tickets and the Ramble batch save, semantic completion feedback (standard haptics), the account settings read and write, the keyboard shortcut preferences read and write, the two read-only search commands (search tasks, Quick Find items), and the two task-link commands (await an accepted task deep link, build a task's shareable https link), and the five Todoist import commands (status, connect in the system browser, run, disconnect, answer the sign-up prompt)
